title: Version 1.1.1 - Mess Menu Parser & Deduplication Fix
notes:
• Enhanced Mess Menu Parser: Added multi-column detection (Day + Dates), full range expansion (e.g. 22nd to 28th), and cycle tracking
• Fixed Duplicate Meals: Prevented multiple weeks/cycles from stacking together onto the same day
• Fixed Repeated Day Items: Isolated date-specific menus so days like Wednesday do not inherit Tuesday items
• Stripped Mess Instructions: Automatically stops parsing at instruction sections and filters out policy rules from menu cards
• Auto-Sanitize & Recovery: Added 'Clean & Deduplicate Menu' and 'Reset to Default Menu' actions to upload options
